metadata.title: Story -> DATA Foundation (IP-on-chain that pivoted to AI training data) + Aria/ARIAIP/APL IP-RWA stack (Kostiner)
metadata.frame: An a16z-backed L1 that started as 'put intellectual property on-chain' (Story Protocol; Programmable IP License + Proof of Creativity; David Kostiner = Chief IP Officer) and, when permissionless IP licensing failed to find product-market fit, REBRANDED (June 2026) to The DATA Foundation and pivoted to selling opt-in human data for AI training - explicitly because 'labs have effectively run out of internet to scrape.' That pivot ties this cluster straight into the map's AI-data / provenance thesis. Aria Protocol (built on Story) tokenizes real IP - starting with music royalties - into Intellectual Property Real-World Asset (IPRWA) tokens ($ARIAIP coordination token; $APL the first product). Catalogs the entities/tokens/people the user named and records the current, quiet state honestly.
metadata.grade: per-edge (fact | contested | unverified). Roles, the rebrand, token migration, funding, launches, and the price/usage collapse are documented; two user premises are addressed in caveats.
caveats: REBRAND (corroborated): On/around 2026-06-25 Story Foundation rebranded to The DATA Foundation and pivoted to AI training data; the $IP token migrates to $DATA 1:1 (1B supply carried forward), Story Network -> DATA Network. Dev entity = PIP Labs (Pen Technology Inc.). The migration direction is $IP -> $DATA (the foundation adopted 'DATA'); some trackers/pages still show $IP during the transition, matching the user's 'partly moved' observation.

PRIOR PROJECT / TOKEN $HAVE (lead, UNVERIFIED): a close observer recalls an earlier, possibly-defunct data project whose token was $HAVE (not 'Data Haven' as first thought). No connection between $HAVE and the Story->DATA Foundation rename has been independently corroborated in this pass; in the reviewed sources 'DATA' is the NEW June-2026 name and $IP migrates to $DATA. Recorded as an OPEN LEAD to reconcile, not asserted - present both accounts with dates once a $HAVE source is found.

QUIET / THIN USAGE (user premise - corroborated): $IP launched Feb 2025, peaked ~$14.78 (Sept 2025), now ~98% lower (~$500M FDV) on LESS THAN $100/day on-chain revenue; the Feb-13-2026 unlock was delayed to Aug-13-2026 (SIP-00009/00010) amid supply-overhang fears and 'usage remains thin.' Aria/IPRWA payouts are early-stage with limited public reporting. Per doctrine, this silence + thin activity is a RISK SIGNAL, not proof of wrongdoing - it cuts both ways.

LEGAL FILINGS (user question): NO litigation, enforcement, or fraud allegation against Kostiner, Story/DATA Foundation, PIP Labs, Aria, ARIAIP/APL, or Aria Protocol Labs surfaced this pass. This is a VC-backed, still-operating project in steep drawdown - NOT a documented pop-up/exit scam. Real (non-accusatory) risks: novel/untested off-chain enforceability of on-chain IP claims, dependence on the off-chain legal wrapper, a 98% token drawdown with near-zero revenue, thin float + unlock overhang, jurisdictional participation limits.
metadata.method: CryptoBriefing/The Defiant/crypto.news (Story->DATA rebrand, 2026-06); GlobeNewswire/Manila Times + datafdn.org (transition + DATA Network/Trace/Poseidon/Kled); CoinDesk 2026-02 (unlock delay, thin usage, <$100/day); Tiger Research ($IP -98%); PRNewswire (Aria $15M); Barchart/Finviz (Aria x RESCENE x MUZE 'Busy Boy', IP Strategy/IPST).

edges.notes: Co-founding partner & Chief IP Officer of Story; the on-chain-IP-as-tradable-asset thesis (fact).
SY Lee, Story co-founder; explained the Feb-2026 unlock delay (need time for real use cases; on-chain revenue ~0); after the DATA rebrand stays on as an adviser (fact).
PIP Labs (Pen Technology Inc.) is the core developer of Story / the DATA Foundation stack (fact).
a16z Crypto led Story's funding (~$54M Sept 2023; ~$80M+ total) and publicly supported the 2026 unlock delay to limit supply shocks (fact).

2026-06-25: Story Foundation rebranded to The DATA Foundation, pivoting from IP-on-chain to AI TRAINING DATA ('labs have effectively run out of internet to scrape'). $IP -> $DATA 1:1 (1B supply); Story Network -> DATA Network. New infra: Trace (on-chain data-provenance receipts), Poseidon (model-ready datasets), contributor apps Numo/Kled. HEALTH: $IP down ~98% from ~$14.78 (Sept 2025); ~$500M FDV on <$100/day on-chain revenue; unlock delayed to Aug-13-2026 (fact of rebrand + metrics; a foundation scam-warning was issued re fake migration prompts).
edges.source: CryptoBriefing/The Defiant 2026-06; CoinDesk 2026-02; datafdn.org; weex.com news (Story renamed to DATA Foundation, $IP->$DATA 1:1)

edges.notes: Named CEO of the DATA Foundation at the rebrand; Kled founder Avi Patel joins as chief data officer/adviser (fact).
Kled's marketplace for user-consented data added ~1.5B records to the network; part of the opt-in human-data supply (Numo + Kled) feeding Poseidon datasets with Trace provenance receipts (fact).

Story provided the on-chain IP substrate (Programmable IP License + Proof of Creativity, each IP linked to an off-chain legal contract) that made Intellectual Property Real-World Assets possible (fact).
Aria is built on Story (a featured Story case study); brings cultural IP (music first) on-chain as liquid tokens (fact).
Aria Foundation stewards the on-chain infrastructure (fact).
Aria Protocol Labs Inc. supports/operates the platform (fact).
Aria operationalizes IPRWA: fractionalizes real IP (music royalties first) into fungible, revenue-generating tokens with secondary trading + lending (fact of product; TAM claims are marketing).
$ARIAIP native/coordination token (1B supply); Binance Alpha listing + airdrop 2025-11-07; deployed on Story (0xC9cb...1Dd52) and BSC (0x2a7e...86836) (fact).

$APL - Aria's FIRST IP-RWA token (2025): partial royalty rights across ~48 songs (artists incl. Justin Bieber, Miley Cyrus, BLACKPINK, BTS). 2026: RESCENE x The MUZE Entertainment single 'Busy Boy' = first NEWLY issued master rights into $APL; master royalties route to $APL holders via smart contract (fact of product design; realized payouts early-stage / limited reporting).
Aria raised ~$15M led by Polychain Capital with Neoclassic and Story Foundation participating - institutional backing, not a bootstrapped pop-up (fact).

IP Strategy (Nasdaq: IPST) publicly issues statements promoting Aria releases (e.g., the RESCENE 'Busy Boy' K-pop master into $APL) - an aligned public-market promoter of the on-Story IP-RWA thesis (fact of statements; nature of any commercial tie not fully public).
